blocks.text: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia — Malaysia anticipates increasing its palm oil exports to the Philippines this year due to expected tighter supply from Indonesia, according to an industry group. “I’m expecting exports to the Philippines to increase,” Malaysian Palm Oil Council (MPOC) CEO Belvinder Sron said on Wednesday. “We probably exported more than 700,000 [metric] tons. We are definitely looking at sustaining that market.” READ: DA seeks P300M to develop local palm oil sector Sron said the archipelago will see increased palm oil shipments primarily due to limited supplies from Indonesia.
